title: Orchestrator tools: lists SlashCommand but it is unavailable at runtime under --agent
description: CAM-240 (PR #185, v0.110.0) made the subagent-orchestrator frontmatter allowlist runtime-binding by spawning the root persona under `claude --agent subagent-orchestrator`, and US-001 reconciled the tools: list to real runtime usage. But subagent-orchestrator.md line 12 still declares SlashCommand, and the CAM-253 live-validation ceremony (2026-07-10) confirmed that under --agent the SlashCommand tool returns No such tool available at runtime. Impact is non-blocking for slash-command dispatch: the CLI thin-proxy send-keys inject path is the sanctioned route (AC#3 proven live). BUT a second gap surfaced while filing this very issue: when the orchestrator is live, `cam issue` injects /cam-issue into the orchestrator pane %0, and under --agent the injected text lands in the composer without submitting (CAM-200) AND cannot be run via the SlashCommand tool, so the orchestrator-side /cam-issue and /cam-review inject path is effectively broken under --agent (worked around here by executing the skill deterministic step `cam issue --file-local` directly). Fix options: (a) drop SlashCommand from the tools: list in .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md + templates/ mirror + re-embed, matching CAM-240 principle that the list must reflect real runtime usage; or (b) wire SlashCommand so it is actually granted under --agent (also repairs the orchestrator-side inject path for /cam-issue and /cam-review). Recommendation: option (b) is the more launch-ready fix because it restores the documented inject-command dispatch path end-to-end, not just tidies the list; if (b) is out of scope, at minimum do (a) so the frontmatter stops advertising a capability the runtime denies. Notes: .claude/agents vs templates/ dual-copy is per-file (diff before assuming re-embed); re-run embed-vendor:check if templates/ changes. Related: CAM-200 (send-keys lands in composer without submit), CAM-240 US-001.
